_about: Reviewed names for PTCG-database (ptcgdb) Japanese set codes (owner-approved 2026-09-27). code: ptcgdb set_id today. set_id: published set ID ('ja-' prefix where the code is an English set ID; xy6/xy7 fold into xy6-b/xy7-b). name: published sets.name / cards.set_name = '{code_display}: {name_en}'. name_en: TCGCSV category 85 group name where TCGplayer lists the product (source tcgcsv:<groupId>), else translated from the official Japanese product name in raw_data.sources (source manual). series: 'Japanese <era>'. For folded codes the published set's own row gives name/series. See docs/plans/japanese-set-names.md.
